# Settings list (generated by `python3 tools/settings_list.py`, run again after changing rows)

Label limit 17 characters (the value pill starts at x 304), value limit 27, help text goes on a second line at about 27 characters per line.

```
 # Group           Label                len  Values
 1 BIOS            Language               8  Japanese, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian   [longest 8]

                   help (28): Set the clock of the console
```
